court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Family Court, Osmanabad, Petition A No. 79 of 2021 (Old H.M.P. No. 134 of 2018)
case_name: Yashwant Waman Ubale vs Shubhangi Yashwant Ubale And Anr

parties.respondent_defendant: Shubhangi Yashwant Ubale and Meghraj Nivruti Sable, wife and another

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioner and respondent got married in 2012, had a daughter in 2013. Respondent filed petition under Section 13(1)(i)(ia)(ib) of Hindu Marriage Act on ground of cruelty.

legal_principles.principle: A person who has been deserted by their spouse for two consecutive years can file a petition for divorce.
legal_principles.held: The petitioner failed to prove that respondent No. 1 had deserted him for a period of two consecutive years before filing the petition.

legal_principles.principle: A person who has been harassed by their spouse can file a petition for divorce.
legal_principles.held: The petitioner was harassed by respondent No. 1, but failed to prove the extent of harassment.

outcome.final_order: The appeal is allowed and the judgment and decree passed by the trial court are set aside. The matter is remitted back to the trial court for fresh disposal.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
use_for_drafting: drafting a divorce petition under Hindu Marriage Act
